1	import Foundation
2	import SwiftData
3	import WCIWKit

5	/// Central coordinator for the user's watchlist: add/remove, refresh from TMDB, and
6	/// episode-watched bookkeeping.
7	///
8	/// All `ModelContext` mutations performed by this class run on the main actor — callers
9	/// are expected to pass the SwiftUI environment's context. The "last refresh" timestamp is
10	/// persisted in `UserDefaults` under `watchlistLastRefresh`.
11	@MainActor
12	final class WatchlistManager: ObservableObject {
13	    static let shared = WatchlistManager()
14	
15	    private static let lastRefreshKey = "watchlistLastRefresh"
16	
17	    private let tmdbService: TMDBService?
18	
19	    private let defaults: UserDefaults
20	
21	    let refreshPolicy: WatchlistRefreshPolicy
22	
23	    @Published private(set) var isRefreshing = false
24	
25	    var lastRefreshDate: Date? {
26	        get { defaults.object(forKey: Self.lastRefreshKey) as? Date }
27	        set { defaults.set(newValue, forKey: Self.lastRefreshKey) }
28	    }
29	
30	    /// - Parameters:
31	    ///   - tmdbService: TMDB client. Defaults to a service constructed from `Info.plist`.
32	    ///     Passing `nil` and having no configured API key disables network refresh — the manager
33	    ///     still works for local watchlist mutations.
34	    ///   - defaults: Backing store for the last-refresh timestamp. Defaults to `.standard`.
35	    ///   - refreshPolicy: Staleness policy. Defaults to 24-hour refresh.
36	    init(
37	        tmdbService: TMDBService? = nil,
38	        defaults: UserDefaults = .standard,
39	        refreshPolicy: WatchlistRefreshPolicy = WatchlistRefreshPolicy()
40	    ) {
41	        self.tmdbService = tmdbService ?? (try? TMDBService())
42	        self.defaults = defaults
43	        self.refreshPolicy = refreshPolicy
44	    }
45	
46	    // MARK: - Add/Remove Operations
47	
48	    /// Adds an item to the watchlist if not already present.
49	    ///
50	    /// - Parameters:
51	    ///   - media: The media to add.
52	    ///   - context: SwiftData context. Inserts are made here; saving is up to SwiftData autosave.
53	    ///   - posterData: Optional pre-fetched poster bytes for offline display.
54	    /// - Returns: The newly created `WatchlistItem`, or `nil` if the item was already in the watchlist.
55	    /// - Note: For TV shows, fetches airing info from TMDB before insertion; a network failure is
56	    ///   non-fatal and the item is inserted with no next-episode metadata. Also triggers
57	    ///   `NotificationManager.requestPermissionIfNeeded()` as a side effect.
58	    @discardableResult
59	    func addToWatchlist(_ media: Media, context: ModelContext, posterData: Data? = nil) async -> WatchlistItem? {
60	        // Check if already in watchlist
61	        if isInWatchlist(mediaId: media.id, context: context) {
62	            return nil
63	        }
64	
65	        // For TV shows, fetch airing info
66	        var airingInfo: TVShowAiringInfo?
67	        if media.mediaType == .tv, let service = tmdbService {
68	            do {
69	                airingInfo = try await service.getTVShowAiringInfo(tvId: media.id)
70	            } catch {
71	                // Continue with nil airing info if fetch fails
72	            }
73	        }
74	
75	        // Create and insert the item
76	        let item = WatchlistItem(from: media, airingInfo: airingInfo, posterData: posterData)
77	        context.insert(item)
78	
79	        // Request notification permission if not yet determined
80	        await NotificationManager.shared.requestPermissionIfNeeded()
81	
82	        return item
83	    }
84	
85	    /// Removes the item with the given media ID and cascade-deletes its `WatchedEpisode` records.
86	    ///
87	    /// - Returns: `true` if an item was removed; `false` if no matching item existed.
88	    @discardableResult
89	    func removeFromWatchlist(mediaId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> Bool {
90	        guard let item = fetchWatchlistItem(mediaId: mediaId, context: context) else {
91	            return false
92	        }
93	        context.delete(item)
94	
95	        // Cascade: delete all watched episode records for this show
96	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
97	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId }
98	        )
99	        if let episodes = try? context.fetch(descriptor) {
100	            for episode in episodes {
101	                context.delete(episode)
102	            }
103	        }
104	
105	        return true
106	    }
107	
108	    /// Whether a watchlist item exists for the given media ID.
109	    func isInWatchlist(mediaId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> Bool {
110	        fetchWatchlistItem(mediaId: mediaId, context: context) != nil
111	    }
112	
113	    /// Looks up a watchlist item by media ID. Returns `nil` if not found or the fetch fails.
114	    func fetchWatchlistItem(mediaId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> WatchlistItem? {
115	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchlistItem>(
116	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId }
117	        )
118	        return try? context.fetch(descriptor).first
119	    }
120	
121	    /// All watchlist items sorted by `dateAdded` descending (newest first).
122	    /// Returns `[]` on fetch failure.
123	    func fetchAllWatchlistItems(context: ModelContext) -> [WatchlistItem] {
124	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchlistItem>(
125	            sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.dateAdded, order: .reverse)]
126	        )
127	        return (try? context.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
128	    }
129	
130	    // MARK: - Refresh Logic
131	
132	    /// Whether the watchlist is past its refresh interval relative to `currentDate`.
133	    /// Delegates to `refreshPolicy`. `currentDate` is injectable for tests.
134	    func needsRefresh(currentDate: Date = Date()) -> Bool {
135	        refreshPolicy.needsRefresh(lastRefreshDate: lastRefreshDate, currentDate: currentDate)
136	    }
137	
138	    /// Refreshes airing info if the policy says it's due, or unconditionally when `force` is true.
139	    ///
140	    /// - Parameters:
141	    ///   - context: SwiftData context used to read and update items.
142	    ///   - force: When `true`, bypasses the staleness check.
143	    ///   - currentDate: Reference "now" — used for both the staleness check and the new
144	    ///     `lastRefreshDate` written to `UserDefaults`. Defaults to `Date()`.
145	    /// - Note: Updates `lastRefreshDate` on completion (success or partial failure).
146	    func refreshIfNeeded(context: ModelContext, force: Bool = false, currentDate: Date = Date()) async {
147	        guard force || needsRefresh(currentDate: currentDate) else {
148	            return
149	        }
150	
151	        await refreshAllAiringInfo(context: context)
152	        lastRefreshDate = currentDate
153	    }
154	
155	    /// Refreshes TMDB airing info for every TV show on the watchlist (movies are skipped).
156	    ///
157	    /// Network failures per item are non-fatal — the item retains its existing data and the
158	    /// loop continues. Saves the context once at the end and reschedules pending episode
159	    /// notifications with the new data.
160	    ///
161	    /// - Note: Sets `isRefreshing` to `true` for the duration of the call.
162	    func refreshAllAiringInfo(context: ModelContext) async {
163	        guard let service = tmdbService else { return }
164	
165	        isRefreshing = true
166	        defer { isRefreshing = false }
167	
168	        let items = fetchAllWatchlistItems(context: context)
169	
170	        for item in items {
171	            // Only refresh TV shows, not movies
172	            guard item.isTVShow else { continue }
173	
174	            do {
175	                let airingInfo = try await service.getTVShowAiringInfo(tvId: item.mediaId)
176	                item.update(with: airingInfo)
177	            } catch {
178	                // Keep existing data if refresh fails
179	            }
180	        }
181	
182	        // Explicitly save changes to persist updated airing info
183	        try? context.save()
184	
185	        // Reschedule episode notifications with updated airing data
186	        await NotificationManager.shared.rescheduleEpisodeNotifications(items: items)
187	    }
188	
189	    /// Refreshes airing info for a single TV item. No-ops for movies.
190	    /// Saves the context on success; on network failure the existing data is kept.
191	    func refreshAiringInfo(for item: WatchlistItem, context: ModelContext) async {
192	        // Only refresh TV shows, not movies
193	        guard item.isTVShow, let service = tmdbService else { return }
194	
195	        do {
196	            let airingInfo = try await service.getTVShowAiringInfo(tvId: item.mediaId)
197	            item.update(with: airingInfo)
198	            try? context.save()
199	        } catch {
200	            // Keep existing data if refresh fails
201	        }
202	    }
203	
204	    // MARK: - Episode Tracking
205	
206	    /// Marks an episode as watched. No-ops if a record for this `episodeId` already exists.
207	    func markEpisodeWatched(
208	        mediaId: Int,
209	        episodeId: Int,
210	        seasonNumber: Int,
211	        episodeNumber: Int,
212	        context: ModelContext
213	    ) {
214	        guard !isEpisodeWatched(episodeId: episodeId, context: context) else { return }
215	
216	        let record = WatchedEpisode(
217	            episodeId: episodeId,
218	            mediaId: mediaId,
219	            seasonNumber: seasonNumber,
220	            episodeNumber: episodeNumber
221	        )
222	        context.insert(record)
223	    }
224	
225	    /// Removes the watched record for `episodeId`. No-ops if no such record exists.
226	    func markEpisodeUnwatched(episodeId: Int, context: ModelContext) {
227	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
228	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.episodeId == episodeId }
229	        )
230	        guard let record = try? context.fetch(descriptor).first else { return }
231	        context.delete(record)
232	    }
233	
234	    /// Toggles the watched state for an episode.
235	    /// - Returns: `true` if the episode is now marked watched, `false` if it was just unmarked.
236	    @discardableResult
237	    func toggleEpisodeWatched(
238	        mediaId: Int,
239	        episodeId: Int,
240	        seasonNumber: Int,
241	        episodeNumber: Int,
242	        context: ModelContext
243	    ) -> Bool {
244	        if isEpisodeWatched(episodeId: episodeId, context: context) {
245	            markEpisodeUnwatched(episodeId: episodeId, context: context)
246	            return false
247	        } else {
248	            markEpisodeWatched(
249	                mediaId: mediaId,
250	                episodeId: episodeId,
251	                seasonNumber: seasonNumber,
252	                episodeNumber: episodeNumber,
253	                context: context
254	            )
255	            return true
256	        }
257	    }
258	
259	    /// Whether a watched record exists for the given episode ID.
260	    func isEpisodeWatched(episodeId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> Bool {
261	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
262	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.episodeId == episodeId }
263	        )
264	        let count = (try? context.fetchCount(descriptor)) ?? 0
265	        return count > 0
266	    }
267	
268	    /// All watched-episode records for a given show. Order is unspecified.
269	    func watchedEpisodes(for mediaId: Int, context: ModelContext) -> [WatchedEpisode] {
270	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
271	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId }
272	        )
273	        return (try? context.fetch(descriptor)) ?? []
274	    }
275	
276	    /// Number of watched episode records for one season of one show.
277	    func watchedEpisodeCount(for mediaId: Int, seasonNumber: Int, context: ModelContext) -> Int {
278	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
279	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId && $0.seasonNumber == seasonNumber }
280	        )
281	        return (try? context.fetchCount(descriptor)) ?? 0
282	    }
283	
284	    /// Marks every episode in `episodes` as watched. Duplicates are filtered by `markEpisodeWatched`.
285	    func markSeasonWatched(mediaId: Int, episodes: [Episode], context: ModelContext) {
286	        for episode in episodes {
287	            markEpisodeWatched(
288	                mediaId: mediaId,
289	                episodeId: episode.id,
290	                seasonNumber: episode.seasonNumber,
291	                episodeNumber: episode.episodeNumber,
292	                context: context
293	            )
294	        }
295	    }
296	
297	    /// Deletes all watched-episode records for the given show and season.
298	    func markSeasonUnwatched(mediaId: Int, seasonNumber: Int, context: ModelContext) {
299	        let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<WatchedEpisode>(
300	            predicate: #Predicate { $0.mediaId == mediaId && $0.seasonNumber == seasonNumber }
301	        )
302	        guard let episodes = try? context.fetch(descriptor) else { return }
303	        for episode in episodes {
304	            context.delete(episode)
305	        }
306	    }
307	
308	}

4	/// SwiftData record marking a single TV episode as watched by the user.
5	///
6	/// `episodeId` is the TMDB episode ID and is the unique key. `mediaId` denormalizes the show

8	@Model

10	    @Attribute(.unique) var episodeId: Int
11	
12	    var mediaId: Int
13	
14	    var seasonNumber: Int
15	
16	    var episodeNumber: Int
17	
18	    var dateWatched: Date
19	
20	    init(
21	        episodeId: Int,
22	        mediaId: Int,
23	        seasonNumber: Int,
24	        episodeNumber: Int,
25	        dateWatched: Date = Date()
26	    ) {
27	        self.episodeId = episodeId
28	        self.mediaId = mediaId
29	        self.seasonNumber = seasonNumber
30	        self.episodeNumber = episodeNumber

1	import Foundation
2	import UserNotifications
3	import SwiftData
4	import WCIWKit
5	
6	/// Coordinator for all local notifications: permission, scheduling, badge management,
7	/// and tap-handling routing.
8	///
9	/// Persists user prefs (`notificationsEnabled`) and last-foreground timestamp (`lastOpenedDate`)
10	/// in `UserDefaults`. Wraps `UNUserNotificationCenter` and turns `NotificationContent` payloads
11	/// into `UNNotificationRequest`s. Identifier conventions: `episode-<mediaId>`, `streaming-<mediaId>`.
12	@MainActor
13	final class NotificationManager: ObservableObject {
14	    static let shared = NotificationManager()
15	
16	    @Published private(set) var isAuthorized = false
17	
18	    @Published var pendingMediaId: Int?
19	    @Published var pendingMediaType: MediaType?
20	
21	    private static let notificationsEnabledKey = "notificationsEnabled"
22	
23	    private static let lastOpenedDateKey = "lastOpenedDate"
24	
25	    var lastOpenedDate: Date {
26	        get {
27	            let interval = UserDefaults.standard.double(forKey: Self.lastOpenedDateKey)
28	            return interval > 0 ? Date(timeIntervalSince1970: interval) : .distantPast
29	        }
30	        set {
31	            UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue.timeIntervalSince1970, forKey: Self.lastOpenedDateKey)
32	        }
33	    }
34	
35	    var notificationsEnabled: Bool {
36	        get { UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey: Self.notificationsEnabledKey) }
37	        set { UserDefaults.standard.set(newValue, forKey: Self.notificationsEnabledKey) }
38	    }
39	
40	    private init() {
41	        Task { await refreshAuthorizationStatus() }
42	    }
43	
44	    // MARK: - Permission
45	
46	    /// Prompts the user for notification permission.
47	    ///
48	    /// - Returns: `true` if granted, `false` if denied or if the request errored.
49	    /// - Note: On grant, sets `notificationsEnabled = true` (user preference). Updates `isAuthorized`.
50	    func requestPermission() async -> Bool {
51	        do {
52	            let granted = try await UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
53	                .requestAuthorization(options: [.alert, .badge, .sound])
54	            isAuthorized = granted
55	            if granted {
56	                notificationsEnabled = true
57	            }
58	            return granted
59	        } catch {
60	            return false
61	        }
62	    }
63	
64	    /// Requests permission only if the user has not yet been asked.
65	    /// No-ops when status is `.authorized`, `.denied`, or `.provisional`.
66	    func requestPermissionIfNeeded() async {
67	        let settings = await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().notificationSettings()
68	        guard settings.authorizationStatus == .notDetermined else { return }
69	        _ = await requestPermission()
70	    }
71	
72	    /// Re-reads system authorization status into `isAuthorized`. Call after app foreground
73	    /// so view state reflects changes made in Settings.app.
74	    func refreshAuthorizationStatus() async {
75	        let settings = await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().notificationSettings()
76	        isAuthorized = settings.authorizationStatus == .authorized
77	    }
78	
79	    /// `true` only when the user has both system authorization and the in-app `notificationsEnabled`
80	    /// toggle on. Scheduling functions short-circuit on `false`.
81	    func shouldScheduleNotifications() -> Bool {
82	        isAuthorized && notificationsEnabled
83	    }
84	
85	    // MARK: - Episode Notifications
86	
87	    /// Cancels all pending episode notifications and re-schedules them from current watchlist data.
88	    ///
89	    /// - Parameter items: Current watchlist. Non-TV items and items without `nextEpisodeDate` are
90	    ///   skipped.
91	    /// - Note: Removes pending requests whose identifier starts with `"episode-"`. Schedules
92	    ///   replacement notifications in chronological order, with badge counts (1, 2, 3, ...)
93	    ///   assigned to episodes that fire after `lastOpenedDate`. Earlier episodes carry no badge.
94	    ///   Silently returns when scheduling is disabled.
95	    func rescheduleEpisodeNotifications(items: [WatchlistItem]) async {
96	        guard shouldScheduleNotifications() else { return }
97	
98	        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
99	
100	        // Remove all existing episode notifications
101	        let pendingRequests = await center.pendingNotificationRequests()
102	        let episodeIds = pendingRequests
103	            .filter { $0.identifier.hasPrefix("episode-") }
104	            .map(\.identifier)
105	        center.removePendingNotificationRequests(withIdentifiers: episodeIds)
106	
107	        // Build content for all eligible episodes
108	        var contentItems: [(content: NotificationContent, airDate: Date)] = []
109	        for item in items where item.isTVShow {
110	            guard let airDate = item.nextEpisodeDate else { continue }
111	
112	            guard let content = NotificationContentBuilder.episodeNotification(
113	                mediaId: item.mediaId,
114	                title: item.title,
115	                seasonNumber: item.nextSeasonNumber,
116	                episodeNumber: item.nextEpisodeNumber,
117	                episodeName: item.nextEpisodeName,
118	                airDate: airDate
119	            ) else { continue }
120	
121	            contentItems.append((content, airDate))
122	        }
123	
124	        // Schedule chronologically so badge values (1, 2, 3...) match air order
125	        let sortedItems = contentItems.sorted { $0.airDate < $1.airDate }
126	        var badgeOffset = 0
127	        for (content, airDate) in sortedItems {
128	            if airDate > lastOpenedDate {
129	                badgeOffset += 1
130	                await scheduleNotification(content, badgeCount: badgeOffset)
131	            } else {
132	                await scheduleNotification(content)
133	            }
134	        }
135	    }
136	
137	    // MARK: - Movie Availability Notifications
138	
139	    /// Schedules an immediate "now streaming" notification for a watchlisted movie.
140	    ///
141	    /// Badge value is set to the count of upcoming episode notifications plus 1, so the badge
142	    /// reflects total unseen items.
143	    /// - Note: Silently returns when scheduling is disabled.
144	    func notifyMovieAvailable(item: WatchlistItem, serviceName: String) async {
145	        guard shouldScheduleNotifications() else { return }
146	
147	        let content = NotificationContentBuilder.movieAvailableNotification(
148	            mediaId: item.mediaId,
149	            title: item.title,
150	            serviceName: serviceName
151	        )
152	
153	        // Count pending episode notifications that will fire after lastOpenedDate
154	        let center = UNUserNotificationCenter.current()
155	        let pendingRequests = await center.pendingNotificationRequests()
156	        let episodeCount = pendingRequests
157	            .filter { $0.identifier.hasPrefix("episode-") }
158	            .compactMap { $0.trigger as? UNCalendarNotificationTrigger }
159	            .compactMap { (trigger: UNCalendarNotificationTrigger) -> Date? in
160	                Calendar.current.date(from: trigger.dateComponents)
161	            }
162	            .filter { $0 > lastOpenedDate }
163	            .count
164	
165	        await scheduleNotification(content, badgeCount: episodeCount + 1)
166	    }
167	
168	    // MARK: - Scheduling
169	
170	    private func scheduleNotification(_ content: NotificationContent, badgeCount: Int? = nil) async {
171	        let notificationContent = UNMutableNotificationContent()
172	        notificationContent.title = content.title
173	        notificationContent.body = content.body
174	        notificationContent.categoryIdentifier = content.categoryIdentifier
175	        notificationContent.threadIdentifier = content.threadIdentifier
176	        notificationContent.sound = .default
177	        notificationContent.userInfo = [
178	            "mediaId": content.mediaId,
179	            "mediaType": content.mediaType
180	        ]
181	
182	        if let badgeCount {
183	            notificationContent.badge = NSNumber(value: badgeCount)
184	        }
185	
186	        // Create trigger
187	        let trigger: UNNotificationTrigger?
188	        if let triggerDate = content.triggerDate {
189	            let components = Calendar.current.dateComponents(
190	                [.year, .month, .day, .hour, .minute],
191	                from: triggerDate
192	            )
193	            trigger = UNCalendarNotificationTrigger(dateMatching: components, repeats: false)
194	        } else {
195	            // Immediate delivery (for movie availability)
196	            trigger = nil
197	        }
198	
199	        let request = UNNotificationRequest(
200	            identifier: content.identifier,
201	            content: notificationContent,
202	            trigger: trigger
203	        )
204	
205	        do {
206	            try await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().add(request)
207	        } catch {
208	            // Notification scheduling failed — non-fatal
209	        }
210	    }
211	
212	    // MARK: - Badge Management
213	
214	    /// Records the current time as `lastOpenedDate` and clears the app icon badge.
215	    /// Call on app foreground / scene activation.
216	    /// - Note: Writes to `UserDefaults` and calls `setBadgeCount(0)`. Errors from the system
217	    ///   are swallowed.
218	    func clearBadge() async {
219	        lastOpenedDate = Date()
220	        try? await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().setBadgeCount(0)
221	    }
222	
223	    // MARK: - Cancellation
224	
225	    /// Cancels every pending notification request and clears the badge.
226	    func cancelAllNotifications() {
227	        UNUserNotificationCenter.current().removeAllPendingNotificationRequests()
228	        Task { await clearBadge() }
229	    }
230	
231	    /// Cancels both the episode and streaming notifications associated with one media item.
232	    /// Targets identifiers `"episode-<mediaId>"` and `"streaming-<mediaId>"`.
233	    func cancelNotifications(for mediaId: Int) {
234	        let identifiers = ["episode-\(mediaId)", "streaming-\(mediaId)"]
235	        UNUserNotificationCenter.current().removePendingNotificationRequests(withIdentifiers: identifiers)
236	    }
237	
238	    // MARK: - Notification Response Handling
239	
240	    /// Records a tapped notification so SwiftUI can navigate to the related media's detail.
241	    ///
242	    /// Stores the values in `pendingMediaId` / `pendingMediaType`. No-ops when either input is
243	    /// missing or when `mediaTypeRaw` is not a recognized `MediaType`.
244	    func handleNotificationTap(mediaId: Int?, mediaTypeRaw: String?) {
245	        guard let mediaId,
246	              let mediaTypeRaw,
247	              let mediaType = MediaType(rawValue: mediaTypeRaw) else { return }
248	        pendingMediaId = mediaId
249	        pendingMediaType = mediaType
250	    }
251	
252	    // MARK: - Notification Categories
253	
254	    // MARK: - Debug Helpers
255	
256	    #if DEBUG
257	    func ensureDebugPermission() async -> String? {
258	        let settings = await UNUserNotificationCenter.current().notificationSettings()
259	        switch settings.authorizationStatus {
260	        case .authorized:
261	            return nil
262	        case .notDetermined:
263	            let granted = await requestPermission()
264	            return granted ? nil : "Permission denied"
265	        case .denied:
266	            return "Notifications denied in Settings"
267	        default:
268	            return "Notification permission unavailable"
269	        }
270	    }
271	
272	    func scheduleTestEpisodeNotification() async -> String {
273	        if let error = await ensureDebugPermission() {
274	            return error
275	        }
276	
277	        let content = UNMutableNotificationContent()
278	        content.title = "Breaking Bad"
279	        content.body = "Felina (S5 E16) airs today"
280	        content.categoryIdentifier = NotificationCategory.newEpisode.rawValue
281	        content.threadIdentifier = "episode-1396"
282	        content.sound = .default
283	        content.badge = NSNumber(value: 1)
